prompt.text:
Implement a safe HTML renderer for a session catalogue. Export exactly `{ renderSessions }` using CommonJS. The input is one of `{ status: 'loading' }`, `{ status: 'error', message }`, or `{ status: 'ready', items }`. Loading returns `

Loading sessions…

`. Error messages must be strings and render inside `

`. Ready items must be an array of objects containing non-empty string fields `id`, `title`, `topic`, `summary`, `room`, `day`, `start`, and `end`. Duplicate IDs or malformed states throw `TypeError`. An empty ready list returns `

No sessions available.

`. Otherwise render tiles in input order as `

TITLE

TOPIC

SUMMARY

ROOM

DAY START–END
`. Escape `&`, `<`, `>`, `"`, and `'` in every interpolated value. Do not mutate the state or item array. Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
